title: I kept two cards and paid four life
story: My opponent had a full hand across the table when I started the draw step at twelve life with Sylvan Library in play. I drew my normal card, then chose to draw two more with the Library trigger. All three were distinct from the cards I had held at the start of the turn. I selected two of the newly drawn cards: one went back on top of my library, and I paid four life to keep the other. My life total fell to eight. I still had Lightning Bolt and Black Vise as part of my plan, but the Library had bought only one extra card, not three.
review: Normal draw 1 plus optional 2 Library draws = 3 this turn. Choose two among those; put one back and pay four life for other. Life 12->8; two of three cards remain, exactly one extra kept. Other cited cards documented in Vice Age.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
candidateStatus: not accepted; pending ten-article checkpoint and deeper deck research
